name: Active account without MFA
rationale: An active account with no second factor is the single most common way an organisation is breached.
remediation: Enrol the account in multi-factor authentication, or deprovision it.

name: Administrator who has not signed in
rationale: Standing privilege that nobody is using is pure risk: it will not be noticed when it is abused.
remediation: Remove the administrative role, or confirm the account is still needed.
condition: is_admin and (last_login_at is null or last_login_at < days_ago(90))

name: Account in an external group
rationale: Membership of an external group widens who can see internal material.

name: Workspace account with no directory counterpart
rationale: An account the identity provider does not know about will not be deprovisioned when its owner leaves.
remediation: Link the account to a person, or remove it.
condition: has_entity("workspace" where status == "active") and not has_entity("idp")

name: Suspended account that still holds admin
rationale: Suspension that leaves privilege behind is not suspension.
